title: Skip release checks for non-release tasks

issue.title: TASK-c7f2 Skip release checks for non-release tasks

description: The version-release.yml workflow runs version-validation and GitHub Release creation on every merge to main, requiring the application version to strictly increase. Non-release tasks (docs, refactor, chore) that do not change the version fail the release check. Add an optional skipRelease flag so such tasks skip release checks.
requirements: Add an optional boolean skipRelease field to task metadata in tasks/index.json and tasks/<id>.json.
Validate the skipRelease field in scripts/validate-tasks.mjs (boolean type, index/task-file consistency).
Add scripts/release-skip.mjs that reads the merged PR body, finds the referenced TASK id, and reports whether release checks should be skipped.
Gate every step of version-release.yml on the skip result so non-release tasks do not run version validation or create GitHub Releases.
Mark a7c3 (self-host Supabase auth) as skipRelease: true.
definitionOfReady: GitHub Issue #143 exists and defines the requested behavior.
The release-check failure for non-release merges was reproduced on PR #139 merge to main.
scripts/validate-tasks.mjs is the single validation entry point run by CI.
acceptanceCriteria: Task with skipRelease: true skips version-validation and GitHub Release creation after merge to main.
Regular tasks still run release checks normally (skip=false).
npm run tasks:validate passes with the new field.
Unit tests cover skip detection (skip / no-task / missing-file cases).
technicalApproach: release-skip.mjs parses GITHUB_EVENT_PATH (or PR_BODY env), extracts TASK-<hex> via regex, and reads tasks/<id>.json for skipRelease === true.
version-release.yml adds a release_skip step that writes skip=true/false to $GITHUB_OUTPUT; every downstream step uses if: steps.release_skip.outputs.skip != 'true'.
validate-tasks.mjs accepts optional boolean skipRelease in both index entries and task files, rejecting type mismatches and index/task-file inconsistency.
next-env.d.ts is removed from git tracking (git rm --cached) so the .gitignore rule takes effect; the file remains on disk for Next.js.
definitionOfDone: Changes delivered through a task PR targeting main.

history.details: Registered from GitHub Issue #143 after the a7c3 branch work was reattributed.
Added skipRelease flag, release-skip.mjs, validate-tasks validation, gated version-release.yml steps, marked a7c3 as skipRelease, and untracked next-env.d.ts.

decisionLog.decision: Gate release checks on an explicit task flag rather than requiring a version bump for every merge.
decisionLog.rationale: Non-release tasks (docs, refactor, chore) legitimately do not change the application version; forcing a patch bump or failing CI is noise. An opt-out flag keeps release checks meaningful while letting routine merges pass.

decisionLog.decision: Resolve task metadata relative to process.cwd() in release-skip.mjs.
decisionLog.rationale: GitHub Actions runs scripts from the repo root, matching how validate-tasks.mjs and other scripts resolve paths; unit tests inject tasksDir explicitly for isolation.
